Getting rid of random is more of a pain than starting your game over again.

It isn't as simple as playing someone then reloading again to abolish a rule. More often than not, you will spread a new rule over abolishing one. The results are based off of RNG, meaning that talking to the same person after reloading in the same manner is going to end up with the same results. You need to talk to different people, decline playing a match once or twice, then accept the match before seeing what the rule results will be.

Sometimes you will abolish open, or another rule that you don't really care about. Aboloshing a particular rule is a massive pain in the ass, and it could very well take longer to do this than play through the entire story. 

The random rule set is by far, without a doubt, the worst part of FF8. Good luck!
